b_static.why: the F1_b reference end poses are not a snug nest. f105-118: <=0.4 mm (pass). f119-123: the beige is 0.7-0.8 cm off the blue axis and crosses the unflared wall at blue height 8.7-8.9 cm by 2.7-3.2 mm. f126-160: the beige axis is tilted 4.6-7.1 deg against the blue axis (the blue reference leans 4.1-5.7 deg from vertical, the beige 0.8-3.1 deg) and crosses the flared rim (blue h 16.95-17.05 cm, azimuth -114..-128 deg) by 4.2-9.1 mm; its tilted bottom edge also dips up to 2.75 mm below the floor top (f141). Diagnostic with only the relative tilt removed: 0 mm on f150-160, <=1.3 mm at f140, still >2 mm on f118-132, f135-136, f139, f144-147 (the 0.3-0.9 cm off-axis offsets). The plan's flare is defined for the coaxial end-nest pose, so the literal check cannot pass without changing the rule; the sim cannot hold the reference's 5-7 deg relative tilt either way (it settles the beige coaxially).

deviations_from_plan: Target scene k10_ep10_nest_b (coordinator update, F1-b) instead of k10_ep10_nest; archive path ...\k10_ep10_nest_b\scene.tgz.

Marker removal: the plan rule (>6 mm beyond the per-height median radius) finds the 4 spheres; the whole sphere plus the outer-side overhang within 2 mm of its footprint is cut and the hole closed on the marker-free outer wall (removing only the >6 mm vertices would leave 6 mm stubs). Inner wall/cavity untouched; result is a closed 2-manifold that passes CoACD's own manifold/self-intersection check, so CoACD runs without preprocessing.

Flare: the plan's monotone profile is computed against the exact cross-sections of the beige CoACD hulls (worst twist) and the slab inner faces including the 15-deg chord sag (~0.4 mm); the slabs can only vary linearly between their 9 band edges, so the edge values are the LP minimum covering the profile. Rim flare 6.52 mm (plan estimate 4-5 mm marker-free).
d_end comes from the k10_ep10_nest_b reference: 5.748 cm median f124-160 (min 5.572), floor top 5.548 (plan estimate 5.65 -> 5.45 on its emulated F1).

Check b: penetration measured two ways (through-wall radial metric that can see a thin wall being crossed, and the plan's nestplan.py pen()); both exceed 2 mm. Coaxial drop judged against the actual floor top (5.548), stop = deepest pose with <=0.5 mm penetration.

Check c: blue movement judged against a blue-alone settle from the same pose (the reference blue leans 1.7-5.5 deg and falls upright by itself, 6.8-8.7 mm); tunnelling judged on the final state, transient dip reported.
